title: Admissable: Training Reinforcement Learning Agents against Adversarial Missingness
abstract: arXiv:2609.15297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In order to make Reinforcement Learning algorithms applicable in real world scenarios, safety must be ensured even under adverse operating conditions. In this work, we consider the challenge of adversarial feature missingness: a scenario in which an adversary occludes features from the agent's observation in order to reduce performance as much as possible. We formally define adversarial missingness for Reinforcement Learning and compare it to the related concepts of $\ell_\infty$-norm bounded adversarial perturbations and learning with missing data. We develop an adversarial training algorithm and show its effectiveness in increasing robustness against adversarial missingness on three MuJoCo benchmark environments. Compared to a baseline trained with random uniform missingness, our method achieves better robustness on all three tasks.

translated_title: Admissable：针对对抗性特征缺失训练强化学习智能体
translated_abstract: 为了使强化学习算法能够适用于现实世界场景，即使在恶劣的运行条件下也必须确保安全性。在本工作中，我们考虑了对抗性特征缺失的挑战：即对手从智能体的观测中遮挡特征，以尽可能降低其性能的场景。我们正式定义了强化学习中的对抗性缺失，并将其与ℓ∞范数有界对抗扰动以及缺失数据学习等相关概念进行了比较。我们开发了一种对抗训练算法，并在三个MuJoCo基准环境中展示了其在提升对抗性缺失鲁棒性方面的有效性。与使用随机均匀缺失训练的基线相比，我们的方法在所有三个任务上都取得了更好的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文正式定义了强化学习中的对抗性特征缺失问题，并提出一种对抗训练算法，在三个MuJoCo基准环境中显著提升了智能体面对对手遮挡观测特征时的鲁棒性，优于使用随机均匀缺失训练的基线方法。
